task:
Galaxy map: hover/focus cards and nearby name labels for real catalogue stars, with overlap handling and a keyboard-accessible list (map review finding M10). apps/web only.

VERIFIED ON MAIN (dd45ee34): `apps/web/src/lib/spatial/galaxy-labels.ts` `galaxyLabelCandidates()` draws system label candidates only from FINDER `finder-systems` layers and keeps only selected ones; `systemPoints()` ignores CATALOGUE contributions entirely. `ExploreWorkspace.svelte` `TARGET_HOVERED` only tracks `region` targets (`hoveredRegionId`). So a field of clickable but unnamed catalogue dots is what the user sees; hovering a catalogue star shows nothing.

WHAT TO DO:
1. Hover/focus card: when the pointer rests on (or keyboard focus reaches) a catalogue star or Finder marker, show a small card near the pointer with the system name, the raw catalogue star class (e.g. "G2", never the derived family label), distance from the current anchor when one exists, and "Select" / "Inspect" actions. Catalogue stars become hoverable targets: `TARGET_HOVERED` must carry `system` targets with `systemId64` and `name` (extend the pick path in `babylon/adapter.ts` only as far as needed to report hover for both star batches from PR 984 — the catalogue batch when it is pickable, the Finder batch always).
2. Nearby labels: `galaxyLabelCandidates` gains catalogue points (from CATALOGUE `catalogue-stars` layers) and ranks candidates: selected, hovered, reference/anchor, Finder results, then the N nearest catalogue stars to the screen centre (N bounded, e.g. 12 at ≤ 500 LY range, fewer as range grows, none above the local-streaming band). An overlap chooser drops a label whose projected box intersects a higher-ranked one; a tie goes to the brighter/nearer star. Labels preserve identity (system id64) through rendering, picking and hover.
3. Accessibility: a keyboard-reachable "Nearby systems" list (collapsed by default, under the map) exposes the same candidate set as buttons that select/focus the system; the canvas's existing focusable behaviour is kept. The hover card is `role="tooltip"` and never traps focus.
4. Performance: candidate ranking and overlap resolution run only when the camera settles or the candidate set changes (reuse the existing settled-focus mechanics), never per frame; bound the work to the candidate set, not all streamed stars.
5. Do not change thresholds, materials, star geometry or the detail policy.

TESTS (vitest): `galaxyLabelCandidates` includes catalogue points and ranks selected > hovered > anchor > Finder > nearest; overlap chooser drops the lower-ranked overlapping label and keeps identities; label count bounds by range; adapter NullEngine test that hovering a catalogue star reports a `system` target with its id64 and name; component tests for the hover card content (raw class shown, derived label not), the Nearby systems list and keyboard selection; axe on the card and list. Existing label, adapter and workspace tests must keep passing.

VALIDATION: in apps/web `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`. CHANGES.md: one dated 2026-11-02 entry; note the visible change needs Product E2E/visual validation before production promotion and is not deployed.
